LanguageData.LP_ClockworkToy.label: clockwork toy
LanguageData.LP_ClockworkToy.description: A rock gnome style clockwork gadget: fully wound, a copper beetle spins on its little stand, flaps its wings and spits a string of tiny sparks. Only one person can play at a time, and it looks nice in a room too.
LanguageData.LP_KoboldSpikePit.label: kobold spike pit
LanguageData.LP_KoboldSpikePit.description: A shallow pit dug by kobolds, its bottom full of sharpened stakes and covered with branches and leaves. Whoever steps in is stabbed by the stakes (sharp 20, armor penetration 15%; big creatures over body size 1.5 take only half). Triggers 3 times, then the pit collapses and must be set again. Placing it requires at least one kobold in the colony.
